_comment: Operators below were transcribed directly from the user's own screen recordings of platform.worldquantbrain.com/learn/operators (two recordings: one covering Logical through Group, a second confirmed to start at the true top of the page and end at the same last entry, group_zscore, as the first). Combined, this is now the COMPLETE 'base' tier operator list - 66 operators across Arithmetic, Logical, Time Series, Cross Sectional, Vector, Transformational, and Group. KNOWN GAP: the page itself states more operators unlock at Expert/Master/Grandmaster tiers - those are not captured here since neither recording showed them (may require a higher account tier to even view). 'fields' below is still the original small starter set - separate task, untouched by this update.

operators.name: abs
operators.usage: abs(x) - absolute value of x, removing any negative sign

operators.name: add
operators.usage: add(x, y, filter=false), or x + y - adds two or more inputs element-wise

operators.name: densify
operators.usage: densify(x) - collapses a grouping field's many buckets down to only the buckets actually in use

operators.name: divide
operators.usage: divide(x, y), or x / y - x divided by y; guard against div-by-zero with divide(x, add(y, 0.0001))

operators.name: inverse
operators.usage: inverse(x) - reciprocal of x (1/x); guard against x=0 with inverse(add(x, 0.0001))

operators.name: log
operators.usage: log(x) - natural logarithm of x; x should be positive

operators.name: max
operators.usage: max(x, y, ...) - maximum value across 2+ inputs

operators.name: min
operators.usage: min(x, y, ...) - minimum value across 2+ inputs

operators.name: multiply
operators.usage: multiply(x, y, ..., filter=false), or x * y - multiplies two or more inputs element-wise

operators.name: power
operators.usage: power(x, y) - x raised to power y (x^y); can drop the sign of x if y is non-integer, use signed_power to preserve it

operators.name: reverse
operators.usage: reverse(x) - returns -x

operators.name: sign
operators.usage: sign(x) - +1 for positive, -1 for negative, 0 for zero, NaN stays NaN

operators.name: signed_power
operators.usage: signed_power(x, y) - x raised to power y, result keeps the sign of x

operators.name: sqrt
operators.usage: sqrt(x) - non-negative square root; equivalent to power(x, 0.5)

operators.name: subtract
operators.usage: subtract(x, y, filter=false), or x - y - subtracts left to right, 2+ inputs supported

operators.name: and
operators.usage: and(input1, input2) - 1 if both inputs are 1 ('true'), else 0

operators.name: if_else
operators.usage: if_else(input1, input2, input3) - if input1 is true returns input2, else input3

operators.name: lt
operators.usage: input1 < input2 - 1 if input1 smaller than input2, else 0

operators.name: le
operators.usage: input1 <= input2 - 1 if input1 smaller or equal to input2, else 0

operators.name: eq
operators.usage: input1 == input2 - 1 if equal, else 0

operators.name: gt
operators.usage: input1 > input2 - 1 if input1 larger than input2, else 0

operators.name: ge
operators.usage: input1 >= input2 - 1 if input1 larger or equal to input2, else 0

operators.name: ne
operators.usage: input1 != input2 - 1 if different, else 0

operators.name: is_nan
operators.usage: is_nan(input) - 1 if input is NaN, else 0

operators.name: not
operators.usage: not(x) - logical negation: 0 if x is 1, 1 if x is 0

operators.name: or
operators.usage: or(input1, input2) - 1 if either input is 1 ('true'), else 0

operators.name: days_from_last_change
operators.usage: days_from_last_change(x) - number of days since x's value last changed

operators.name: hump
operators.usage: hump(x, hump=0.01) - limits the magnitude of changes in x, reducing turnover

operators.name: kth_element
operators.usage: kth_element(x, d, k, ignore='NaN') - k-th value from x's last d days; used for backfilling

operators.name: last_diff_value
operators.usage: last_diff_value(x, d) - most recent value of x in the past d days that differs from today's

operators.name: ts_arg_max
operators.usage: ts_arg_max(x, d) - days since the max value of x occurred within the last d days (0 = today)

operators.name: ts_arg_min
operators.usage: ts_arg_min(x, d) - days since the min value of x occurred within the last d days (0 = today)

operators.name: ts_av_diff
operators.usage: ts_av_diff(x, d) - x minus ts_mean(x, d), with NaNs ignored in the mean

operators.name: ts_backfill
operators.usage: ts_backfill(x, lookback=d, k=1) - replaces NaNs with the most recent valid value in the lookback window

operators.name: ts_corr
operators.usage: ts_corr(x, y, d) - Pearson correlation between x and y over the past d days

operators.name: ts_count_nans
operators.usage: ts_count_nans(x, d) - count of NaN values in x over the past d days

operators.name: ts_covariance
operators.usage: ts_covariance(y, x, d) - covariance between y and x over the past d days

operators.name: ts_decay_linear
operators.usage: ts_decay_linear(x, d, dense=false) - linear decay/smoothing of x over d days, weighting recent values more

operators.name: ts_delay
operators.usage: ts_delay(x, d) - value of x from d days ago

operators.name: ts_delta
operators.usage: ts_delta(x, d) - x minus its value d days ago (momentum/change)

operators.name: ts_mean
operators.usage: ts_mean(x, d) - simple average of x over the past d days

operators.name: ts_product
operators.usage: ts_product(x, d) - product of x's values over the past d days

operators.name: ts_quantile
operators.usage: ts_quantile(x, d, driver='gaussian') - ts_rank of x transformed via a distribution's inverse CDF

operators.name: ts_rank
operators.usage: ts_rank(x, d, constant=0) - rank of today's value of x within its own trailing d-day history

operators.name: ts_regression
operators.usage: ts_regression(y, x, d, lag=0, rettype=0) - regression of y on x over d days, returns chosen parameter

operators.name: ts_scale
operators.usage: ts_scale(x, d, constant=0) - scales x to a 0-1 range based on its min/max over the past d days

operators.name: ts_std_dev
operators.usage: ts_std_dev(x, d) - standard deviation of x over the past d days

operators.name: ts_step
operators.usage: ts_step(1) - counter of days, increments by 1 each day

operators.name: ts_sum
operators.usage: ts_sum(x, d) - sum of x's values over the past d days

operators.name: ts_zscore
operators.usage: ts_zscore(x, d) - how many standard deviations today's x is from its own trailing d-day average

operators.name: normalize
operators.usage: normalize(x, useStd=false, limit=0.0) - centers x by subtracting the daily cross-sectional mean, optionally divides by std and clamps to [-limit, +limit]

operators.name: quantile
operators.usage: quantile(x, driver='gaussian', sigma=1.0) - ranks then reshapes x's cross-sectional distribution (gaussian/cauchy/uniform)

operators.name: rank
operators.usage: rank(x, rate=2) - cross-sectional rank of x among all instruments, spread evenly between 0.0 and 1.0

operators.name: scale
operators.usage: scale(x, scale=1, longscale=1, shortscale=1) - rescales x so absolute values across instruments sum to a target book size

operators.name: winsorize
operators.usage: winsorize(x, std=4) - caps x within std standard deviations of the mean, reducing outlier impact

operators.name: zscore
operators.usage: zscore(x) - x's distance from the cross-sectional mean, measured in standard deviations

operators.name: vec_avg
operators.usage: vec_avg(x) - mean of all elements in a vector field, per instrument/date, collapsing it to a single value

operators.name: vec_sum
operators.usage: vec_sum(x) - sum of all elements in a vector field

operators.name: bucket
operators.usage: bucket(rank(x), range='0, 1, 0.1') or bucket(rank(x), buckets='2,5,6,7,10') - sorts ranked data into custom groups for use with group_* operators

operators.name: trade_when
operators.usage: trade_when(x, y, z) - only updates the alpha's value when condition x is met, holds otherwise, exits (NaN) when condition z is met

operators.name: group_backfill
operators.usage: group_backfill(x, group, d, std=4.0) - fills NaNs using a winsorized mean of same-group instruments over the past d days

operators.name: group_mean
operators.usage: group_mean(x, weight, group) - harmonic mean of x within each group

operators.name: group_neutralize
operators.usage: group_neutralize(x, group) - subtracts the group (e.g. industry) mean from x, removing group-level bias

operators.name: group_rank
operators.usage: group_rank(x, group) - rank of x within its own group only, between 0.0 and 1.0

operators.name: group_scale
operators.usage: group_scale(x, group) - normalizes x to a 0-1 range within each group

operators.name: group_zscore
operators.usage: group_zscore(x, group) - x's distance from its group's mean, measured in standard deviations
